ctx.x: So we're talking to Kenny Clarke. It's the 30th of September, 1977. Helen Oakley Dance (UNINTELLIGIBLE), and in Paris, and Kenny's going to do the interview now. Now we're going to see what kind of a shot we've got on that. Okay, Kenny. Just let me get a little shot on your voice.
Okay, Helen. I think this is a very nice thing, and I think we should get some very nice things done.
Good enough. Okay. Well, Kenny, what we want to do is go right back to the beginning.
